why_agent_cannot: identity verification is required and cannot be performed by an agent
what_human_must_do: Download the app for iOS or Android from dexari.com .
Create an account with an email code or a Google or Apple login, then set up a passkey. Dexari says this takes no KYC or personal data.
Fund the wallet. You can receive crypto from another wallet, or buy it through MoonPay, which may ask you to complete its own KYC.
Add USDC to your trading account and trade spot or perps in the app. Warning With up to 40x leverage, a small move against you can liquidate a position.
Check your points in the Profile section. Distributions arrive on Wednesdays.
costs: The fee page lists 0.10% per trade on perps and spot at the entry tier. At the top tier that falls to 0.01% on perps and 0.02% on spot. Tiers follow your rolling 30-day volume, and the page says Hyperliquid's own fees may also apply. Moving funds from the perps account back to the main wallet costs Hyperliquid's $1 withdrawal fee.
